title: MemoryBackend::update_object uses std::any::Any downcast — documents broken pattern
description: tests/common/mod.rs:253-271 — MailBackend::update_object takes O::Patch (always serde_json::Value in practice) but the method body must use Any downcast to recover it. This is a type-system hole: the trait cannot express that Patch must be Value, so the backend silently fails if Patch is ever a different type. Real backends implementing this trait will copy this pattern. Fix: add a default bound or constrain Patch to impl Into<serde_json::Value>, or take serde_json::Value directly for a json-patch method.
